summary: Sente is a G$ (GoodDollar) gifting app on Celo: send GoodDollar to any wallet with a short note, or fund a shareable gift card that the recipient claims from a link. This milestone adds the on-chain work: two small contracts (a note-carrying transfer and a funded claim-code card) with tests, the send panel wired to the real wallet transfer, gift links that carry real G$, and a claim page the recipient opens to receive the money.
direction: Warm wooded editorial: off-white green-tinted background, deep forest green, white paper cards, Fraunces display over DM Sans, generous space, 24px rounded gift-card surfaces with hairline borders and a faint leaf wash behind the hero; calm and human, like a note tucked into paper. Keep the existing tokens and layout and add on-chain states in the same voice.

contracts.name: SenteGifts
contracts.purpose: Pass G$ from the caller to any wallet with a short note in one signed transaction, and keep a public record of recent gifts so the app can list them.
state: IERC20 immutable gd (GoodDollar on this network)
struct Gift { address from; address to; uint96 amount; uint64 at; string note; }

functions.name: constructor
functions.does: stores the G$ token immutable and reverts on the zero address

functions.name: sendGift
functions.does: rejects a zero recipient, recipient == sender, zero amount and a note over 240 bytes; pulls G$ from the caller with safeTransferFrom straight to the recipient, appends the gift, emits GiftSent; nonReentrant

functions.name: onTokenTransfer
functions.does: ERC-677 one-step path: reverts NotGoodDollar() unless msg.sender is gd, decodes (address to, string note) from data, forwards the received amount to the recipient and records it; nonReentrant

functions.name: recent
functions.does: view: up to limit gifts, newest first, at most 20 per call

functions.name: giftsBy
functions.does: view: gift indexes recorded from one sender, newest first, at most the 50 most recent

functions.name: giftAt
functions.does: view: the full gift struct at an index

events: GiftSent(uint256 indexed id, address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 amount, string note, uint256 at)
invariants: the contract's G$ balance is zero after every send, because it forwards and never holds
a send of 0 reverts and records nothing
a send to the zero address or to the sender reverts
totalSent equals the sum of the amounts of all recorded gifts
recent(5) on an empty contract returns an empty array and never returns more rows than asked for

contracts.name: SenteCards
contracts.purpose: Fund a shareable gift card: lock G$ behind a secret claim code, let whoever opens the link claim it once, and let the sender reclaim it after an expiry.
state: struct Card { address sender; uint96 amount; uint64 expiry; bool claimed; string note; bytes32 codeHash; }

functions.name: constructor
functions.does: stores the G$ token immutable and reverts on the zero address

functions.name: fundCard
functions.does: rejects a zero amount, a reused id, a zero codeHash, an expiry in the past or more than 365 days out, and a note over 240 bytes; pulls G$ from the caller and stores the card; emits CardFunded; nonReentrant

functions.name: claimCard
functions.does: rejects an unknown id, an already claimed card, a card past its expiry and a wrong code (must equal codeHash); marks it claimed then safeTransfers to msg.sender; emits CardClaimed; nonReentrant

functions.name: reclaim
functions.who: the card's sender, after the expiry
functions.does: returns the amount to the sender and marks the card spent so it cannot be claimed twice; emits CardReclaimed; nonReentrant

functions.name: cardInfo
functions.does: view: sender, amount, expiry, claimed, note and codeHash for an id

functions.name: cardCount
functions.does: view: how many cards have been funded

functions.name: cardsBy
functions.does: view: a sender's card ids, newest first, at most the 50 most recent

functions.name: outstanding
functions.does: view: the contract's own G$ balance, which is everything still claimable

events: CardFunded(bytes32 indexed id, address indexed sender, uint256 amount, uint64 expiry, string note)
CardClaimed(bytes32 indexed id, address indexed claimer, uint256 amount)
CardReclaimed(bytes32 indexed id, address indexed sender, uint256 amount)
invariants: a card pays out exactly once: claim then claim reverts, and claim then reclaim reverts
a claim with a wrong code reverts and moves nothing
reclaim before the expiry reverts and reclaim from anyone but the sender reverts
the contract's G$ balance equals the sum of the unclaimed, unexpired card amounts
funding a card with a reused id reverts
